messages:
Nina Ortiz: Heads-up: SI partner bundle for HelixHW listing needs to ship this week. Required items: SOC2 summary, redacted pen-test report, supplier questionnaire, NDA ack, and a partner-only artifact package for SI engineers. Where are current owners?
Ethan Li: I own the supplier questionnaire and NDA. I can pull SOC2 summary from the vault, but need to confirm redaction rules for the pen test.
Priya Shah: Legal/security want per-asset redaction reasons and a manifest that lists original vs redacted filenames + reasons. They prefer a YAML manifest for readability.
Compliance Bot: Reminder: any presigned links sent to external SI teams must have DLP review and be tagged `marketplace-evidence`. Default retention=90 days. See https://internal.redwood/docs/presign-policy
Nina Ortiz: Good. Proposed flow: 1) Ethan stages raw artifacts to staging bucket with 36h TTL. 2) Security (Priya) runs redaction pass and produces two bundles: public and partner-only (partner bundle keeps device IDs masked but accessible via partner ACL). 3) I draft attestation language for telemetry and signing. 4) Jordan will handle portal upload and compliance-id mapping.
Ethan Li: I'll upload to s3://marketplace-staging/helixhw-2130456789/ and enable access logging. Will tag objects with `marketplace-evidence` and `si-partner`. Presign TTL=36h.
Priya Shah: Redaction rules (short):
```
- remove internal IPs/hostnames
- strip exploit PoCs and raw shell logs
- mask device serial/model numbers in public bundle
- preserve high-level findings, CVE references, and mitigations
- include per-file redaction_reason in manifest.yml
```
Legal wants the manifest to include a statement: "redaction did not alter telemetry schema" with hashes for preserved telemetry files.
Jordan (Marketplace): Portal needs `compliance_id` and `artifact_type` fields on upload. Also flag: marketplace QA will run an automated scan on public bundle for disallowed PII. If QA fails we get a rejection and have to re-upload.
Nina Ortiz: Action items: Ethan = upload + presigns; Priya = redact + manifest.yml; Nina = attestation draft + signoff; Jordan = portal mapping + final upload.
Ethan Li: Raw zip uploaded. Posted presign links to #private-partners. Tags and access logging set.
Compliance Bot: Auto-check: tags present, access_logging=true. DLP review required for external recipients.
Priya Shah: Starting redaction now. Will produce `manifest.yml` with entries like: `- file: pen-test-2025.pdf\n  redacted: pen-test-2025-redacted.pdf\n  reason: mask device models` and a `telemetry_hashes` section. ETA: tomorrow 11:00 PT.
Jordan (Marketplace): I'll reserve a draft compliance_id in the portal so we can link artifacts quickly. Also scheduling a short QA window next Tues.
Nina Ortiz: Thanks. If Legal asks for finer redaction, we may need to delay public listing and note it in the marketplace release tracker. Keep updates here. :thumbsup:
Ethan Li: Will monitor DLP signoff and update thread.
Priya Shah: Will cc Legal on the manifest once ready.
Jordan (Marketplace): Noted. I'll prepare portal fields and a pre-check script for PII scanning.
Nina Ortiz: Great teamwork — flag anything blocking the upload here.
